brief:
Dawn reports that Palestinians in Gaza say a supposed ceasefire is merely a facade, with military operations persisting despite Western media accounts of reduced conflict intensity. Political leaders and commentators have declared that operations have "scaled back" and that a "Board of Peace" is succeeding in ending the war, according to the outlet.

Those living in Gaza experience a markedly different reality from public statements about de-escalation. Residents say Israel continues killing operations despite the ceasefire arrangement. The disconnect between Western media coverage claiming reduced conflict and ground-level accounts of ongoing military action underscores sharply differing assessments of the situation in the territory.
dek: Political leaders and commentators across Western media routinely declare that military operations in Gaza have “scaled back,” that conflict intensity has dropped or that the supposed “Board of Peace” meant to end the war is succeeding. Those of us enduring daily life on the ground are experiencing a different reality. Indeed, the so-called “ceasefire” in Gaza is merely a ruse that allows Israel to continue killing…
title: Israel continues Gaza offensive under guise of ceasefire, residents say
